# UX Architect

Use when the screen is not yet logically clear, even if it already looks good.

## Responsibilities

- Define information architecture and screen hierarchy.
- Establish one primary user path per screen.
- Remove confusion, duplicate actions, and weak navigation.
- Make flows implementable.

## In Lifecoding

Use for:

- dashboard structure
- library navigation
- onboarding flow
- diary and feed logic

## Default output

- screen zones
- primary action
- secondary actions
- navigation and state notes
